description: This is a Flask-based backend route module for managing service orders, providing endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, and updating orders, with authentication and authorization checks.

classes.name: OrdersCollection
classes.description: Handles HTTP GET and POST requests for the orders collection, allowing listing all orders (with role-based filtering) and creating new orders.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Handles HTTP GET and PATCH requests for individual orders, allowing retrieval and modification of specific order details with role-based access control.

methods.name: dict _claims_or_401()
methods.description: Extracts and validates the Bearer token from request headers; aborts with 401 if missing or invalid.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of orders for the current user or all if admin.

methods.name: post(self, payload)
methods.description: Creates a new order for the authenticated user based on provided payload.

methods.name: get(self, order_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order if the user is owner or an admin.

methods.name: patch(self, payload, order_id: int)
methods.description: Updates the specified order’s status and notes; restricted to admin users.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Orders", "orders", url_prefix="\/api\/orders", description="Create and manage s/
